correctness.rationale: Exchangeable-sign Gram matrix has explicit rank-one plus contrast decomposition. Its tightness is exactly mean-zero and variance n for two shell-sums. With a,b>0 the mean condition makes probabilities b/(a+b),a/(a+b), giving ab=n, plus actual binomial-cardinality equality. The exact ratio R(t) and symmetric factor identity prove strict F(a)>F(b) for all gaps at least four; equal and gap-two cases are the only remaining ones. A direct third-moment expansion proves the cubic defect, with no numerical extrapolation. Standard-library checker performed 70325 integer/rational and direct-enumeration assertions successfully. Proof covers n≥2, third order n≥3; endpoint and singular cases are explicit.

value.rationale: Exact equal-point cubature over whole Hamming layers is a natural stable Fourier measurement design with an unavoidable one-shell kernel. The theorem gives the complete sharp two-layer existence criterion in all cube dimensions, classifies each admissible shell pair, identifies all singular spectra for nonoptimal pairs, and separates strength-two from strength-three designs by an exact Fourier leakage invariant. Neither a known single-shell calculation nor a finite table supplies that classification.
